name: Bugatti EB110 GT (1991-95); SS differences noted
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4400); y half-width from the centre line (symmetric, positive); z from the ground at static ride height
tolerance: overall: from the makers' figures and the dimensioned drawing, exact; profile and part positions: read from orthographic-looking renders (side, front, rear) and the-blueprints 4-view, about +-30 mm (the renders have a little perspective, corrected for)
sources: dimensioned side drawing: length 4400, wheelbase 2550, front overhang 1040, rear overhang 810, height 1114, approach 9deg10', departure 28deg13'
the-blueprints.com EB110 SS 4-view: width 1940, height 1125 (plan read for half-widths)

profile._: the silhouette from the side, [x, z]; top: the centre line (bonnet, screen, roof, engine cover, tail); bottom: the body's lowest edge (arches excluded); the wing above the tail is not in the top line (see parts: wing)

plan._: half-width at x, from the plan (mirrors excluded); the nose is round, widest over the rear wheels

sections._: heights of the main lines at stations: belt = the side glass's foot / the wing crest; shoulder = the widest line's height; sill = the side skirt's foot

frontCrease._: the sharp line across the nose below the lamps, from wing to wing, bowed down a little at the centre

sideCrease._: the top of the side skirt's recess: a crisp horizontal edge from behind the front wheel to the side intake

tailCrease._: the rear face's lower edge over the black valance

parts.inside: units at the back: projector (round, d 80, outboard at y 612, z 630) and fluted halogen reflector (inboard, y 330-560); heater lines printed on the glass

panels._: the body is separate volumes meeting at crisp edges (from the exploded set and the photographs); inside a panel the surface is smooth. Numbers here are read from photographs and the front render: about +-40 mm, to be refined against the images
panels.bonnet: a nearly flat panel, sharp-edged: its sides run straight back at y about 650 from the lamps' outer back corners (x 595) to the screen's corners (x about 1300); between the lamps it reaches forward as a tongue to the bumper's shut line (x about 255, z about 500); the two lamp slots are cut out of its front corners
panels.wingF: each front wing is its own rounded volume outboard of the bonnet's edge: it rises from that edge (a valley, a sharp inside corner along y 650) to a crest at y about 800-870, 40-70 mm above the bonnet's edge, highest over the wheel (z about 750 at x 1040), and runs back into the screen pillar and the door's top; ahead of the wheel it falls to the lamp: its inner face is the lamp slot's outer wall
panels.lampTrough: beside each head lamp, outboard: the wing's front is scooped - a concave channel from the lamp's outer end (the amber indicator sits at its mouth, y 690-800, z 600-635) running back and up between the bonnet's edge and the wing's crest, dying out toward the screen's corner; clearly visible in every front three-quarter photograph
panels.bumperF: a separate volume below the shut line (z about 500 across the nose, running back along the sides at z about 470 to the wheel arch): rounded in plan, its face holding the horseshoe, the two three-slot intakes and the corner ducts; a thin splitter under it
panels.door: scissor door; front edge behind the wing vent, back edge sweeping down and forward; its foot at z about 300 above the skirt's recess
panels.skirt: under the door a deep recess with a sharp upper shelf (z about 412) from x 1420 to the intake's mouth at x 2890; the sill stands out below it (z 124-300)
panels.quarter: the rear wing: widest of the car (y 970-975 at x 3000-3600), a slot along its top behind the door, six oval holes (2 by 3) in the buttress panel above it, the vent at the tail's corner
panels.roof: a narrow glasshouse: wrap-round screen, the side glass leaning in strongly (tumblehome), buttresses running back from the roof to the tail
panels.engineCover: between the buttresses, x 2700-3700, y +-450: glass with black louvre bars (GT)
panels.tail: the tail panel leans: widest at its foot (z about 556); lamps in capsule bezels, slots between; below it the black valance and the rising diffuser
